leftEvidence.title: Humanity is created in God’s image and blessed

points.label: Scale
points.left: Humanity appears collectively as male and female within the whole created order.
points.right: The narrative narrows to one formed human before the garden is described.

points.label: Relationship to God
points.left: Image and likeness language is central.
points.right: Formation and received breath are central.

points.label: Relationship to earth
points.left: Humanity is commissioned in relation to the earth and creatures.
points.right: The human is materially formed from the ground.

payload.posture: Read the broad human commission beside the close-up formation scene.

rightEvidence.title: The man is formed from dust and receives breath

payload.tension: Genesis 1 speaks of humanity collectively as male and female; Genesis 2 narrows to one human formed from dust and animated by breath.
payload.title: Humanity spoken / human formed
